title: Zero-Shot vs Few-Shot Prompting
research_question: Does adding three labeled demonstrations improve classification accuracy on six unseen customer-support messages?
hypothesis: Few-shot prompting will improve classification accuracy.

few_shot.description: Classification instructions with three labeled demonstrations

comparison.interpretation: Both prompting conditions achieved the same reported accuracy.

model_configuration.note: Complete original model settings were not preserved.

limitations: Small evaluation sample of six messages.
Both conditions achieved 100 percent accuracy, creating a ceiling effect.
Complete model settings were not preserved.
No repeated experimental runs were performed.
Original message-level predictions were not recovered.
